name: project-update-router
description: Routes project update authoring to the right format (interactive microsite, long-form doc, Slidev, dashboard, hybrid PPTX) based on audience + distribution + content-shape + sensitivity. Scaffolds content from beads + git log + gstack learnings. Replaces the default PPTX-for-everything muscle memory with format choice that matches message. v0.2.0 adds Extension Consumer Protocol (reads .claude/plugins/*-update/config/ YAMLs) + formalized Auto-pull Protocol (scoped by extension audiences.yaml project fields). Still interpreter-mode; automated generators land in v0.3+.
